title: DeepScribe: reading cuneiform signs on Persepolis tablets
summary: A machine-learning model recognizes signs on tablets from the Persepolis Fortification Archive with about 80% accuracy on tablets excluded from training (over 6,000 annotated images and over 100,000 signs in the database). About 20% of signs are wrong; testing is internal only, and the source is a university announcement.

evidence.tested: Recognition of signs on tablets excluded from training reached about 80% accuracy; the source describes the testing as internal only.
evidence.unknown: About 20% of signs are still wrong; the size of the held-out set and an error breakdown are not given; other uses are described as aspirations.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning model trained on over 100,000 annotated signs from Persepolis Fortification Archive tablet images to recognize cuneiform signs.
